792:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Through $$万丈$$'s contacts, we reached resistance groups across the world and learned the situation on $$翠の地球$$.」

792:t_1:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「From the situation, it seems $$サイデリアル$$'s main force has indeed moved to $$蒼の地球$$.」

792:t_1:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the fighting here is now centered in the south of $$翠の地球$$'s largest landmass... the $$中央大陸$$...」

792:t_1:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「According to $$万丈$$, our former comrades are fighting on that continent too.」

792:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... If they and we operate independently, we should be better able to keep $$サイデリアル$$ in check.」

792:t_1:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Another concern is $$サイデリアル$$'s activity in the $$残されの海$$.」

792:t_1:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's the sea where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is...? It doesn't seem to have any strategic value...」

792:t_1:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's precisely why we must be wary of whatever they are doing there.」

792:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I propose the following strategy.」

792:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll move $c's main force to either the $$中央大陸$$, the heart of the fighting, or the $$残されの海$$, where we've seen suspicious activity...」

792:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And send a force suited to operations in the other area there.」

792:t_1:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll deploy the main force and a detachment simultaneously, then.」

792:t_1:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Since we have no time to spare, that would be the most appropriate course.」

792:t_1:18.en:
$$シャア$$
「How will we organize the forces?」

792:t_1:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let's see... If we go to the $$中央大陸$$, we'll probably use Japan along the way as a staging base...」

792:t_1:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let's send $$ザンボット３$$ and $$ダイターン３$$, along with their close allies: $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$, $$オックス$$, and the $$クラッシャー隊$$.」

792:t_1:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we'll send Ensign $$レド$$, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, and Captain $$ガムリン$$ to the $$残されの海$$.」

792:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「All that remains is to decide where to send the main force.」

792:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the main force heads for the $$中央大陸$$, we'll have $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ensign $$レド$$, and the others head to the $$残されの海$$ as a detachment...」

792:t_1:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If it heads to the $$残されの海$$, we'll send $$ザンボット$$, $$ダイターン$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$, $$オックス$$, and the $$クラッシャー隊$$ to $$ガリア$$.」

792:t_1:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let Captain $$ジェフリー$$, who has combat experience on $$翠の地球$$, decide the main force's course.」

792:t_1:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'll send the main force to the $$中央大陸$$.」
「I'll send the main force to the $$残されの海$$.」

792:t_1:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then the main force will head to the $$中央大陸$$. The $$クォーター$$ will go to the $$残されの海$$ with $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, Captain $$ガムリン$$, and Ensign $$レド$$.」

792:t_1:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Stay safe, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

792:t_1:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll have the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, standing by in orbit, descend here as the situation warrants.」

792:t_1:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At least outwardly, he's moved on and is experimenting with ways to fight in $$ジェニオン$$ without Miss $$スズネ$$.」

792:t_1:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But he isn't the only one in dire straits. Our battles on $$翠の地球$$ will be crucial to escaping our predicament.」

792:t_1:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Since we've already rescued $$オルソン$$, we can expect $$サイデリアル$$ to be sending forces our way.」

792:t_1:35.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$中央大陸$$ and the $$残されの海$$... I'm counting on both groups to fight well.」

792:t_1:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then the main force will head to the $$残されの海$$, and we'll send the super robot team, led by $$ザンボット３$$, to the $$中央大陸$$.」

792:t_1:37.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. Let's leave command to $$ケンジ$$ and $$万丈$$.」

792:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll have the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, standing by in orbit, descend here as the situation warrants.」

792:t_1:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At least outwardly, he's moved on and is experimenting with ways to fight in $$ジェニオン$$ without Miss $$スズネ$$.」

792:t_1:41.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But he isn't the only one in dire straits. Our battles on $$翠の地球$$ will be crucial to escaping our predicament.」

792:t_1:42.en:
$$シャア$$
「Since we've already rescued $$オルソン$$, we can expect $$サイデリアル$$ to be sending forces our way.」

792:t_1:43.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$中央大陸$$ and the $$残されの海$$... I'm counting on both groups to fight well.」

792:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good work with your training, $n. Have a sports drink.」

792:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How is it going? Have you found any clues for a new finishing move?」

792:t_10:7.en:
$n
「If it were that easy, I wouldn't be struggling.」

792:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I fought $$カミーユ$$, $$スザク$$, $$シン$$, $$カレン$$, $$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, $$竜馬$$, and $$クロウ$$ five times each...」

792:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your losses far outnumber your wins. Though I did expect that.」

792:t_10:12.en:
$n
「$$セツコ$$ pointed it out to me, but it seems I'd been relying on $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s power without realizing it.」

792:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... In that case, I recommend fighting without GAI Mode on your next sortie.」

792:t_10:14.en:
$n
「You mean in a real battle...? It might be worth a try.」

792:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Speaking of things worth trying, this is too! Let's put our hearts into today...」

792:t_10:16.en:
$n
「Sorry. No matter how good your advice is, I still can't bring myself to do that.」

792:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's cheer up and get going! Let's put our hearts into today... Business, business!」
